one_line: MIT edits model weights, Anthropic adds proof tool, AI firms boost spending, and services expand worldwide.

themes.title: LLMs edit neural network weights
themes.text: MIT researchers demonstrated that a large language model can examine and modify a neural network’s weights directly, improving performance on MATH‑500 and GSM8K benchmarks.

stories.headline: MIT researchers show LLMs can read and edit neural network weights without retraining

themes.title: Cryptographic verification of model replies
themes.text: Anthropic released FlashProve, an open‑source prototype that generates cryptographic proofs showing a language‑model response came from a specific set of weights, with verification times of 17‑21 seconds on a CPU.

stories.headline: Anthropic releases FlashProve to cryptographically verify AI model responses

themes.title: AI firms boost spending and raise capital
themes.text: Anthropic’s compute costs rose to 58% of revenue and it pledged $895 billion in compute spending while reporting a 1,100% revenue surge; Meta announced a $20 billion cross‑border bond for AI and data‑center expansion; Fal raised $1.3 billion valuing it at $16 billion; Revolut cut AI coding inference costs by about 90% with self‑hosted GLM models.

stories.headline: Anthropic compute costs rise to 58% of revenue in Q3, widening operating loss
Anthropic reports 1,100% revenue surge ahead of IPO, commits $895B to compute
Meta targets at least $20 billion in cross‑border bond offering, debuting euro tranche
AI inference startup Fal valued at $16B after $1.3B funding round
Revolut cuts AI coding inference costs by about 90% with self‑hosted GLM

themes.title: AI services expand globally
themes.text: Apple opened Siri AI to all developers via App Intents in iOS 27.3 beta; OpenAI reported India as its largest ChatGPT market with a doubled user base; NVIDIA deployed physical and agentic AI services in cities across Europe, Asia and the U.S.; Baidu launched Apollo World to simulate up to 100,000 km of robotaxi driving daily.

stories.headline: Apple opens Siri AI to all developers via App Intents in iOS 27.3 beta
India becomes ChatGPT’s largest market by weekly active users, base doubles since Jan 2026
NVIDIA expands physical and agentic AI services to cities worldwide
Baidu launches Apollo World AI system to simulate up to 100,000 km of robotaxi driving daily
